[room 3733133217, day 0.5]
Tropical seasonal forest — buttressed canopy, sun-warmed, damp, on a rise — in the lands of Doaba. The sky above: The sun, a yellow dwarf (G), stands high in the sky. The light is golden. The days are near their longest. The sky is a flat overcast. You can enter the settlement of Doaba. Something ended here: flight.
Here: Dvoashngashngo, Qvoshngavngo, Shngovngo and Shngoqvo, and 63 others.
No direction here is closed; the nearest ground lies N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW.
